description: Detainees are held on military intelligence material they cannot access, for six months at a time, indefinitely renewable. It is very rarely used against Jewish Israelis.
energy_note: Imprisoned by a document nobody will show you.

description: More than 22,000 administrative detention orders, new and renewed, since the start of the Gaza war. Administrative detainees rose from roughly 1,300 before the war to more than 3,300 by August 2026.
energy_note: Three thousand people, no charges between them.

description: The Palestine Center for Prisoners Studies reports that 99% of appeals filed by administrative detainees against extensions are rejected, including by the Supreme Court, often without explanation.
Each period ends with a date the family has counted down to, and can be extended on that day. The release date is real enough to plan around and provisional enough to evaporate.
energy_note: Told he's out in March. Told again in September.

aspect: The household outside reorganises around it
description: A wife becomes the sole earner, sole parent, sole negotiator with lawyers and the sole point of contact for the prison service, indefinitely and with no date at which it resolves.
money_note: Lost household income plus legal and visit costs.
energy_note: Married, and running the house alone, for years.

description: She has explained to the children three times that their father is coming home next month. The fourth time she does not tell them the date at all, and the eldest works out why.
energy_note: Learning not to tell your children good news.

description: More than 22,000 administrative detention orders, new and renewed, have been issued since the start of the Gaza war, with the number of administrative detainees rising from roughly 1,300 before the war to more than 3,300 by August 2026. Riyad al-Ashqar of the Palestine Center for Prisoners Studies said 99% of appeals against extensions are rejected, often without explanation.
energy_note: Twenty-two thousand orders, and a one per cent appeal rate.
